label: 📐 Multiple-comparison correction
description: Adjust p-values for multiple-test inflation. Takes a column of raw p-values, returns adjusted p-values + significance flags under the chosen method (Bonferroni, Holm, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR). Without correction, running 20 tests at α=0.05 yields a 64% chance of a false positive somewhere.

method.label: Method
method.help: fdr_bh = Benjamini-Hochberg (most common); bonferroni = strictest; holm = step-down Bonferroni; fdr_by = Benjamini-Yekutieli (no independence assumption).
